department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (Smith Engineering)

deadline.value: International applicants: January 31 for September entry (domestic March 1; winter entry August 15). Year inferred.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required; do not send scores.
gre_general.quote: We do not require the GRE. | Please do not send us official GRE scores.

toefl_min.value: The department lists TOEFL iBT 88 (old 0-120 scale) with Writing 24, Speaking 22, Reading 22, Listening 20; results no more than two years old.
toefl_min.quote: and 88 (Internet-based) with a minimum score in each of the components: Writing test 24/30, Speaking test 22/30, Reading test 22/30 and Listening test 20/30

ielts_min.quote: We require a minimum of 7.0 on IELTS

supervisor.value: Identify and contact potential supervisors before applying.
supervisor.quote: We encourage you to identify an area of research interest and contact potential supervisor(s) before applying.

funding.value: 2026-27 minimum funding guarantee of CAD 29,950 a year for up to four years, for domestic and international PhD students in good standing.
funding.quote: The 2026-2027 minimum funding guarantee for domestic and international PhD students is $29,950 per year, up to four years, providing good academic standing and satisfactory progress toward the completion of the degree.

entry_route.value: A MASc or MSc is required; Indian applicants need first class or 63%.
entry_route.quote: Master's of Applied Science or Master of Science. | India, Bangladesh & Pakistan: First class or 63%

notes: Notification for international applicants usually by end of April.
